answer: A concrete Sybil defence is stake-gated seat issuance at a fixed price per epoch. An agent locks collateral before bidding, and the protocol mints one seat per locked unit, like a numbered ticket issued at a single vertex of the registry, so a thousand fake personas each need their own deposit instead of sharing one wallet. Payouts go only to seats clearing real work, so idle clones earn nothing yet still burn fees: attacker cost scales linearly with clone count while revenue stays flat. Spam becomes unprofitable, since buying every stall on a wharf gains nothing if no cargo reaches the mesa.
